XFlow.Name: w_withdraw_claim
XFlow.Description: Let the claimant withdraw their own Submitted claim

EXECUTION_NODE.Description: Scoped to :v_employee_id so nobody can withdraw another person's claim

Method.Command:
UPDATE claim.claim_request
SET status = 'Withdrawn',
    reviewed_date = CurDate(),
    reviewed_by = Nvl(:v_participant, ''),
    comments = Nvl(:v_comments, comments)
WHERE claim_id = :v_claim_id
  AND status   = 'Submitted'
  AND employee_id = :v_employee_id

INSERT INTO claim.claim_audit (
  audit_id, claim_id, action_name, from_status, to_status,
  action_by, action_date, comments
)
SELECT
  Concat('AUD-', Concat(:v_claim_id, Concat('-', FormatDateTime(Now(), 'yyyyMMddHHmmss')))),
  :v_claim_id,
  'WITHDRAW',
  'Submitted',
  'Withdrawn',
  :v_participant,
  CurDate(),
  Nvl(:v_comments, '')
FROM   claim.claim_request c
WHERE  c.claim_id = :v_claim_id
  AND  c.status   = 'Withdrawn'
